race.comment: NAUGHTY NURSE (4) is favoured on the strength of her class profile, coming back from provincial CL3 company and returning to a preferred trip off a month between runs. Bold showing anticipated. SECRET CYPHER (2) is the obvious danger after finishing third at Atherton, and the weight relief from 62.5kg to 59kg brings him right into this despite being beaten by YOUMEANDDUPRE there. YOUMEANDDUPRE (7) was unwanted in betting but missed by only a head in that same BM50, has a 1450m win on the board, and gets meaningful weight relief. GOLDEN GLAZE (10) closed off well when beaten just under a length at Townsville and now coming back from provincial CL1 grade with a prior win at this venue. Have to include. Keeping TIPPED OFF (3) as he rises quickly in trip on the short turnaround.
